development_selection_rule: Wins plus half draws over all 12 conditions first; matched outcomes/costs only as tie-breaks. Survival time alone is not a win.

selection_rule_chronology.initial: Wins plus half draws across all twelve development conditions; matched outcomes and cost exchange were generic tie-breaks.
selection_rule_chronology.tie_break_clarification: After F completed and before G results were inspected for selection, same-point candidates were ordered by fewer baseline win-to-loss regressions, then higher sum own net destroyed cost over all twelve conditions, then lower median win seconds.

ordered_criteria.formula: count(reference result == win and candidate result == lose)
sum(military.kills_cost - military.deaths_cost) over the same 12 completed conditions
median(game_seconds for result == win); never reward longer survival in losses

selection.note: Selection is locked before any of the fresh conditions are executed; no subsequent tuning on fresh results.

common_settings.HP: nearest integer percentage; exact platform rounding formula unavailable
common_settings.policy_information: own fog-filtered seat observation and public static rules only

instrumentation.kind: optional local RNG seed for repeatable evaluation

scoring.time_limit_comparison: lexicographic (kills_cost - deaths_cost, assets_value); higher wins; equality draws
scoring.limitation: Local same-tick cutoff statistics can differ from platform latest-observation sampling; not an official platform result.

known_base_center_calibration_difference.platform_documented_fallback: Construction yard position; otherwise center of own buildings, then own units
known_base_center_calibration_difference.local_adapter_fallback: Construction yard position; otherwise first own building or unit
known_base_center_calibration_difference.exposure_audit_scope: Development candidates A through E, including the original GPS-error attempt; F, G and fresh validation were not included in this exposure audit.
known_base_center_calibration_difference.distance_reference: Arithmetic mean of own building or unit positions; the guide says center but its exact fallback formula has not been verified.

policy_hash_method: SHA-256 over sorted altru_redalert/*.py, concatenating each filename then file bytes; not executable or whole repository hash

initial_observation_metadata_supplement.source: first recorded authorized raw observation, not inferred from map filename
initial_observation_metadata_supplement.reason: Initial observation fields are absent in persisted metadata although present in trace. Cause not established; original file remains unchanged.

instrumentation_supplement.reason: The replay started after the display-guard build but before its provenance manifest was written. Original metadata retained.

limitations: All old twelve conditions, including prior holdout, are now development data used for selection.
Development and fresh validation denominators must remain separate; replays are not extra independent samples.
Fixed map/seed assignments still limit generalization even though fresh validation crosses own faction, seat, enemy faction and AI type.
Stock Normal/Rush AI may have privileged engine information and does not establish performance against strong platform or community bots.
No network latency, MCP grants/leases, platform observation truncation or faithful delayed command acknowledgement is modeled.
No SOTA, strongest-bot or guaranteed-win claim is supported.
